rationale: The plan matches the reference closely: subject as a blocking term in both full and reduced models, an LRT for any condition effect, then the three Wald contrasts on the same paired model with ashr/apeglm shrinkage and BH at 0.05, with an explicit control reference level. QC includes VST, PCA and sample-distance heatmap with subject clustering, but coloring by condition and a policy for outliers or shallow samples are not stated; the |log2FC| cutoff is applied post hoc rather than via lfcThreshold in the test. Enrichment was not requested and the reference omits it; the plan adds WikiPathways ORA/GSEA without an explicit ORA universe, collection version, or gene-set size window. The report specifies thresholds and gene counts but not package versions or the design caveats beyond n=4 power.
